level.description: A mutability level (ADR-0012 decision 1): open (replace, extend and relate), extendable (extend and relate, never replace) or locked (no write).
level.title: Mutability Level

description:
A pack's mutability policy file (policy.yaml at the pack root, ADR-0062), named by the optional mutability_policy key of pack.yaml.

Fields
------
schema_version : int
    The shape's version, the integer 1.
kind_defaults : mapping | absent
    The default level of each artifact kind the pack sets one for, keyed by the
    artifact kind token (ADR-0012 decision 4). A kind left out is open.
artifacts : mapping | absent
    The level of single artifacts, keyed by bare URN (<kind>:<id>, never
    pack-qualified). An entry wins over its kind's default.

A target's level in one pack is its artifacts entry, else its kind default, else open. Along a composition closure the highest level wins, and a later pack raises a level but never lowers it (ADR-0012 decision 3, ADR-0062 decision 3).

Role locks and pins (ADR-0030) are reserved: the schema is closed, so a roles or pins key, like any key it does not declare, makes the file unreadable, and a pack whose pack.yaml names an unreadable or missing policy file is unreadable.
